correctness.rationale: The source proves that every solution in the target branch must be \(3^a(2\cdot3^t+1)^b\) with the exponent equation. The new identity \((b+2)(3t-2-a)=3(2t-1)\) is algebraically equivalent to that equation and gives a bijection with nontrivial divisors of \(3(2t-1)\). For the \(a,b\ge2\) branch, exactly the divisors \(1\) and \(3\) are excluded. The converse is independent of the source's implication: direct factorization gives \(\tau(\varphi(3^aP_t^b))=3(a+t)b\) and \(\tau((3^aP_t^b)^2)=(2a+1)(2b+1)\), whose equality is exactly the exponent equation. The verifier exhaustively reproduces the parametrization for \(t\le20\).
